correctness.rationale: Analytic proof verifies hypotheses, definitions and quantifiers. Constant approval welfare 2k establishes Pareto efficiency, pairwise ballot intersections make EJR equivalent JR, run decomposition proves every EJR deviation has at most 4|T|/3 improvers, small omission count separately precludes blocking, and explicit Z/T witnesses every parameter with 4k>=3n and n-k>=4. At n=16,k=12 the four improving voters afford three candidates. Exact-integer finite checker corroborates edge cases but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural two-regular approval cycle is an interpretable stress-test of recent universal Hare-core existence results. The sharp 3/4 threshold plus four-unselected boundary and minimal 16-voter witness expose the precise conditions under which EJR and Pareto efficiency coexist with coalition instability; structural gain bound gives explanatory content beyond brute finite examples. The result concerns an infinite parameter family and motivates fair-selection guarantees stronger than EJR.
